description: A message to the chat from someone other than you (a Bot, another chat, a subagent's answer, a host), as the chat's host records the sender: placed where your messages are, at the right, but grey, with who it's from in a small line at the top of the bubble.
opens: A Bot, another chat or a subagent messages this chat over the mesh
A held message sent with its ↑ (HeldTurn)
Opening a chat whose host's sender store says a message is someone else's

parts.name: bubble
parts.shows: A sent-message bubble (right-aligned, 12px corners, attachments then markdown text), filled with the text colour at 7% (grey) instead of the accent; its text in the normal colour (not dimmed like a queued one). The hidden line the host puts at the head of the text for the agent ("A message from …, not from your user") is never shown; if the host says what to show of it (a held answer), that is shown instead of the full text.

parts.name: from line
parts.shows: At the top of the bubble, right-aligned, wrapping: "from <who>" at 0.85em and 60% opacity. <who> is: "<name>, a Bot" (or "a Bot, a Bot" without a name); "“<chat title>”" (or "a chat"); "subagent “<name>”" (or "a subagent"); a host's name (or "a host"); another kind by its name (or "another"). For anything but a host, " on <host>" follows when the sender's host is known, e.g. "from Ada, a Bot on lab-mac".

parts.name: revert button
parts.shows: As a sent message's (UserTurn): fades in left of the bubble on hover.

phone.does: A long-press reveals the same controls
phone.why: No hover on touch; a long-press is Android's equivalent of the desktop's right-click

actions.does: Tentative revert of it and everything after it, but its words are NOT put in your composer; sending (even with nothing in the composer) makes the revert.

states.name: sender learned late
states.shows: A message first drawn as yours turns into this look in place once the host's sender store arrives and says it's someone else's.
